title: EXECUTION_POLICY_V1
description: Produced by adaptive-model-router (or a reasonable built-in default when the Router is not active) and consumed by scholarly-agent to bound how a workflow stage executes. Describes policy, not private reasoning: it never carries a model name as a hard requirement, chain-of-thought, or a numeric savings guarantee.

mode.description: Coarse execution posture, not a model identifier.

context_policy.description: Guidance on how much context/evidence a stage should gather before acting.

constraints.description: Hard/soft user constraints propagated from the workflow state (see shared/terminology.md).
